options.name: auth_passphrase
options.description: User passphrase for authentication. Ignored for B(NoAuth), otherwise mandatory.

options.name: auth_protocol
options.description: Authentication protocol. Allowed values: * NoAuth * MD5 * SHA Defaults to B(NoAuth).

options.name: portal_key
options.description: The API token for authentication against Infoblox BloxOne API. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_KEY) will be used.

options.name: portal_url
options.description: The Infoblox Cloud Services Portal (CSP) URL. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_URL) will be used.

options.name: privacy_passphrase
options.description: User passphrase for privacy. Ignored for B(NoPrivacy), otherwise mandatory.

options.name: privacy_protocol
options.description: Privacy protocol. Must be B(NoPrivacy) if auth_protocol set to B(NoAuth). Allowed values: * NoPrivacy * DES * AES Defaults to B(NoPrivacy).

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the object

options.name: username
options.description: User name with which to associate security information.
